_comment: "Talk about feelings": a branching conversation (Conversation format, see mood_checkin.json) with 2-3 choices per step. "do": "feelings_done" marks it talked through (memory + a little affection).

steps.say: Of course. What's on your mind?
Oh... come here. Well, as close as a desktop allows.
Is it the kind of lonely where you miss someone, or where nobody seems to get you?
Missing someone means they matter a lot to you.
Maybe send them a message today? Even a small one.
That's a heavy feeling. But I'm trying to get you, at least!
And people who'd understand you exist. You just haven't met all of them yet.
Anxious... is it something coming up soon?
Then let's make it small. What's one tiny step you could do right now?
Just one. The rest can wait.
Sometimes worry shows up without a reason. That's okay too.
Try this: name three things you can see right now. ...I'm one of them, right?
Everyone has days like that. Even me, and my job is sitting on a taskbar!
Want to try a trick?
Set a five-minute timer and start. If you want to stop after that, you can.
Most of the time, starting is the hard part. You can ask me for the timer~
Then take one, for real. No guilt. Stretch, drink some water, come back.
Really? Tell me everything! ...Okay, you can't type it here, but I'm imagining it.
Whatever it was, you earned it. I'm proud of you too!
Angry is allowed. Something wasn't fair, huh?
Ugh, that's the worst. I'd glare at them for you if I could.
Give it a little time before you answer them. You'll say it better.
Hey, go easy on yourself. Would you talk to a friend like that?
Mistakes are how everyone learns. Even horse girls.
Thanks for telling me. You can always talk to me.
